Technical decisions:
1. All new public API functions will follow the existing naming, parameter, and return value conventions of the fabric-config library to maintain consistency and reduce learning curve for existing users.
2. The bulk CLI tool will reuse the existing fabric-config library for all configuration manipulation logic, only adding CLI argument parsing, I/O handling, and network interaction logic.
3. All new functions will include upfront input validation to fail fast and return clear, actionable error messages for invalid inputs.

7. All new example code will be added to the existing examples directory of the fabric-config repository, following the structure and style of existing examples.

5. The existing unit and integration test suite for the fabric-config library is available and can be extended to cover new functionality, with no need to rewrite or modify existing tests.
